title: Clean one surface with the right method

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: Cleaning method follows both surface and product instructions. Cleaning removes ordinary soil; a disinfecting claim needs the particular product’s authorized use and directions. Smell or visible shine does not establish sanitation.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Fictional surface card: sealed washable table, use a water-damp soft cloth with a small amount of compatible mild detergent; wipe away residue and dry; no abrasive powder. Product A card: mild detergent for this sealed surface, dilute only as its actual label directs. Product B card: abrasive powder, not for this surface. No disinfection claim or contamination incident is supplied. These cards are paper-comparison materials, not labels for an unidentified real product.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Choose a compatible comparison method, identify the missing real-world dilution detail and explain why B is unsuitable. Plan the clean/dirty cloth separation.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A product permits one surface but the furniture maker prohibits that ingredient. Does either instruction alone clear use?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: A matches the supplied surface category; before real use obtain the actual dilution/directions, not an invented ratio. B contradicts the no-abrasive requirement. Keep the used cloth away from clean food-contact items. Partial: choose A but invent a concentration. Incorrect: mix products or claim disinfection from fragrance. No actual cleaning occurred in the paper route.
criteria: Both surface and product conditions are respected
Cleaning and disinfection claims remain distinct

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. Both must be compatible; choose an actually supported method or obtain appropriate clarification. Do not test an incompatible chemical to resolve the conflict.
